purpose: Teach: リュック/コスメ/さんま/琵琶湖/ライトアップ/待ち遠しい/リベンジ/新居

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 旅、リュック、大きめサイズ、買った。
lines.en: Just picked up a bigger backpack for the trip.
lines.style: Warm and matter-of-fact, lightly pleased. Quick pace, easy rhythm. The tone of someone sharing something nice without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。コスメ、限定品、欲しい!
lines.en: Oh, nice! There's this limited edition cosmetics line I've been wanting.
lines.style: Eager lean forward. Genuine excitement threading through the words. Bright, conversational rhythm that invites her in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 秋、さんま、食べたいよね。
lines.en: Fall's coming soon — I've been craving sanma. One of those things you can only really do this time of year, you know?
lines.style: Warm nostalgia underneath. Thoughtful pause before 'sanma'. Settling into the comfort of seasonal rhythms. Genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 琵琶湖、いつか、ドライブで行きたい。
lines.en: I've been thinking — one day I want to drive out to Lake Biwa with someone. Just go.
lines.style: Soft, half-dreaming quality. Looking past the present moment. Gentle pace, trailing slightly. A wish rather than a plan.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 冬は、ライトアップ、街、きれいだよね。
lines.en: Winter's really beautiful though — the way the city lights up. It's something special.
lines.style: Tender observation. Soft attack on 'Winter'. Pace slows slightly, savoring the image. Voice carries quiet appreciation without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: クリスマス、待ち遠しい!
lines.en: And Christmas will be here before we know it.
lines.style: Genuine happiness breaking through naturally. Lighter, brighter tone. No performance — just the simple pleasure of something to look forward to.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 前回のテストで負けたから、リベンジ目指す。
lines.en: I lost that test last time, so I'm definitely going for a rematch with the next one.
lines.style: Determination with a hint of competitive fire. Steady, grounded delivery. Not frustrated — focused. The voice of someone who learns from setbacks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 引っ越して、新居、片付け中。
lines.en: I actually just moved into a new place, and I'm still in the middle of unpacking and organizing everything.
lines.style: Warm, slightly tired contentment. Conversational and genuine. A touch of 'this is a process' in the pacing, but genuine pleasure underneath about the space itself.
